notes.title: Version 1.0.9 released
notes.notes:
Hi All

Had to release a patch on day one to fix an issue where the payer will start at the wrong location once beating a boss.
Phew, luckily that was found quickly and all should be good now.
I'm here to assist, let me know if anyone has any other problems

Thank you to all the gamers who came out to support my game on day one.
I appreciate it.

notes.title: Sir War-A-Lot release date set!
notes.notes:
Hi all

I am happy to share that Sir War-A-Lot is ready for release and the the date has been set for 26 March.
Everybody get ready to start throwing some swords around.
